desc:
🔑 KEYS KEYS KEYS... O ALGO, O ALGO 🔑

Your crew has docked at a dark space station orbiting Jupiter. Mateo is trapped somewhere inside - and the station is full of giant o algo KEYS. They hear your footsteps, they see your flashlight, and they never stop hunting.

🚀 Launch with up to 6 players (or invite only your friends in the FRIENDS capsule)
🔦 Sneak through the dark with your flashlight - or turn it off and hide
⚡ Restart the generators to bring the power back
🛌 Hide in sleep pods when a key is chasing you
🆘 Shout HELP and revive your wounded crewmates
🧍 Find Mateo, carry him to the escape pod and get out alive!
🔫 Case-O carries a gun - keys can be knocked down, but never killed

Earn Gold and XP every mission, level up, buy colored suits and new weapons in the lobby, and climb the upvote board.

Play with friends - it's scarier together. 👀
